text:
Maya Chen: FYI — Ventura Logistics account flagged for sharp usage drop this week, renewal in 6 weeks. noticed it during weekly sweep. :thinking_face:
ops-bot: Alert: account_rate_drop detected for account_id=ventura-1234, drop_pct=68, window=14d
Rafael Gomez: Oh wow, 68% is huge. any clue on cause? onboarding issues?
Maya Chen: Not onboarding. They reported a procurement handoff + new legal reviewer last Tuesday. Procurement put a temporary restriction on external data sends to vendors.
Priya Singh: That explains API decline. Are they using our hosted inference or private?
Maya Chen: Hosted. Most calls are from scheduled batch pipelines, so blocking outbound payloads would kill usage.
Jordan Lee: Do we have a list of the endpoints they call most? can we provide a scoped contract sample that satisfies legal?
Maya Chen: Yes — endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. I pulled a quick token breakdown:
```
Last 30d tokens: 1.2M -> 380k (past 7d)
Active API keys: 3 -> 1
Top route: /v1/generate (74% of cost)
```
Maya Chen: They also mentioned a trial with "PulseML" — competitor pitch last week per account notes.
Rafael Gomez: Competitive angle + legal hold = medium risk. What's their contract size?
Maya Chen: ARR ~ $120k. Renewal in 6 weeks, no committed Dedicated.
Priya Singh: Ok. Action plan: 1) Offer scoped data-handling template for legal, 2) propose a short-term sandbox with VPC egress restrictions or bring-your-own-key (BYOK) options, 3) schedule an enablement workshop to demonstrate cost saving from batching.
Jordan Lee: I can draft the template and sample SSO/KMS wording. Rafael — can you own the enablement workshop content? include before/after token & cost numbers.
Rafael Gomez: Yep. I'll assemble a 30-min demo + ROI slide. can we get logs for the affected pipelines to show regression?
Maya Chen: I'll ask CS Ops for pipeline logs and send a meeting invite to their new legal lead and procurement on Monday.
Priya Singh: Recommend we offer a 60-day trial of our Dedicated capacity with restricted egress while legal reviews. Low friction for them and buys time.
Maya Chen: Good idea — I'll float it as an option. Anything else?
Jordan Lee: Also surface the PulseML feature set they highlighted so we can rebut specifics. Priya/Pulse research?
Priya Singh: I'll pull a quick competitive note and NV on differences.
Maya Chen: Ok team — next steps:
- Maya: request logs, meet legal + procurement (Mon)
- Rafael: build demo + ROI (due Wed)
- Jordan: draft legal/KMS wording (Tue)
- Priya: competitive note (Tue)
Maya Chen: Tagging @Rafael for workshop scheduling when ready. :calendar:
Rafael Gomez: Got it. I'll aim for Wed EOD.
ops-bot: Note added to account: "renewal-risk: medium — action plan in thread"
Maya Chen: I'll update renewal tracker and flag for AE to prep commercial options. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
